description: Fixed-order features emitted once for each closed or EOF-flushed TCP/UDP flow generation.

legacy_prefix.requirement: Names, order, units, formulas, and numeric policies are unchanged; values are observed at terminal emission.

emission_contract.cardinality: exactly one row per observed flow generation
emission_contract.tuple_reuse: the trigger packet belongs only to the new generation

statistics_policy.update: n = n + 1; delta = x - mean; mean = mean + delta / n; delta2 = x - mean; M2 = M2 + delta * delta2

active_idle_policy.boundary: a gap is idle only when gap_ns > idle_threshold_ns
active_idle_policy.active_segment: starts at the first packet watermark; an idle boundary finalizes the prior active span; terminal emission finalizes the last active span
active_idle_policy.idle_segment: the entire watermark gap that exceeds the threshold
active_idle_policy.timeout_or_eof_wait: not added to active or idle time

context_policy.freeze_point: first accepted packet of the flow generation after registering the current generation
context_policy.causality: capture order only; later packets and later flow generations cannot change frozen values
context_policy.endpoint_orientation: directed endpoints and ports from the first accepted packet
context_policy.raw_ip_retention: derivation state only; never a model input or exported feature

lifecycle_policy.tcp_reset: TCP flow with any observed RST
lifecycle_policy.tcp_fin_handshake: TCP flow without RST with FIN observed in both directions
lifecycle_policy.tcp_other: every other TCP terminal state, including timeout, tuple reuse, and incomplete FIN

dataset_columns.model_input: exactly one selected feature profile in ascending index order
label: label_binary
label_family

allowed_terminal_information: final packet, byte, flag, window, TTL, payload, and header statistics

sources: reference layer 1: destination port and aggregate byte/packet families
reference layer 2: duration, directional traffic, rates, flags, windows, active time, and protocol families
reference layer 3: duration, directional traffic, TTL, load, state, and destination/service context families
not_claimed: numeric parity with reference active/idle definitions
numeric parity with reference state encoding
numeric parity with reference contextual counters
numeric parity with factorized protocol values

features.name: flow_age_us
features.formula: current nondecreasing flow watermark minus the first packet timestamp, divided by 1000.0
features.zero_policy: 0 when the watermark equals the first packet timestamp

features.name: packet_count
features.formula: count of all accepted packets in this flow generation through the checkpoint

features.name: forward_packet_count
features.formula: count of packets whose direction is forward

features.name: reverse_packet_count
features.formula: count of packets whose direction is reverse

features.name: wire_byte_count
features.formula: sum of PacketView.wire_length over all packets

features.name: forward_wire_byte_count
features.formula: sum of PacketView.wire_length over forward packets

features.name: reverse_wire_byte_count
features.formula: sum of PacketView.wire_length over reverse packets

features.name: packet_length_min
features.formula: minimum PacketView.wire_length over all packets

features.name: packet_length_max
features.formula: maximum PacketView.wire_length over all packets

features.name: packet_length_mean
features.formula: Welford mean of PacketView.wire_length over all packets

features.name: packet_length_std
features.formula: Welford population standard deviation of PacketView.wire_length over all packets

features.name: forward_packet_length_mean
features.formula: Welford mean of PacketView.wire_length over forward packets

features.name: forward_packet_length_std
features.formula: Welford population standard deviation of PacketView.wire_length over forward packets

features.name: reverse_packet_length_mean
features.formula: Welford mean of PacketView.wire_length over reverse packets

features.name: reverse_packet_length_std
features.formula: Welford population standard deviation of PacketView.wire_length over reverse packets

features.name: flow_iat_min_us
features.formula: minimum signed flow IAT in nanoseconds divided by 1000.0
features.zero_policy: 0 when fewer than two flow packets exist

features.name: flow_iat_max_us
features.formula: maximum signed flow IAT in nanoseconds divided by 1000.0
features.zero_policy: 0 when fewer than two flow packets exist

features.name: flow_iat_mean_us
features.formula: Welford mean of signed flow IAT in nanoseconds divided by 1000.0
features.zero_policy: 0 when fewer than two flow packets exist

features.name: flow_iat_std_us
features.formula: Welford population standard deviation of signed flow IAT in nanoseconds divided by 1000.0
features.zero_policy: 0 when fewer than three flow packets exist

features.name: forward_iat_mean_us
features.formula: Welford mean of signed same-direction forward IAT in nanoseconds divided by 1000.0
features.zero_policy: 0 when fewer than two forward packets exist

features.name: forward_iat_std_us
features.formula: Welford population standard deviation of signed same-direction forward IAT in nanoseconds divided by 1000.0
features.zero_policy: 0 when fewer than three forward packets exist

features.name: reverse_iat_mean_us
features.formula: Welford mean of signed same-direction reverse IAT in nanoseconds divided by 1000.0
features.zero_policy: 0 when fewer than two reverse packets exist

features.name: reverse_iat_std_us
features.formula: Welford population standard deviation of signed same-direction reverse IAT in nanoseconds divided by 1000.0
features.zero_policy: 0 when fewer than three reverse packets exist

features.name: packet_rate_per_second
features.formula: packet_count * 1000000.0 / flow_age_us

features.name: wire_byte_rate_per_second
features.formula: wire_byte_count * 1000000.0 / flow_age_us

features.name: forward_reverse_packet_ratio
features.formula: forward_packet_count / reverse_packet_count

features.name: forward_reverse_wire_byte_ratio
features.formula: forward_wire_byte_count / reverse_wire_byte_count

features.name: direction_change_count
features.formula: number of adjacent packets in capture order whose flow directions differ

features.name: tcp_syn_count
features.formula: count of TCP packets with the SYN flag set
features.zero_policy: 0 for UDP flows or when absent

features.name: tcp_ack_count
features.formula: count of TCP packets with the ACK flag set
features.zero_policy: 0 for UDP flows or when absent

features.name: tcp_fin_count
features.formula: count of TCP packets with the FIN flag set
features.zero_policy: 0 for UDP flows or when absent

features.name: tcp_rst_count
features.formula: count of TCP packets with the RST flag set
features.zero_policy: 0 for UDP flows or when absent

features.name: tcp_psh_count
features.formula: count of TCP packets with the PSH flag set
features.zero_policy: 0 for UDP flows or when absent

features.name: tcp_syn_ack_ratio
features.formula: tcp_syn_count / tcp_ack_count

features.name: tcp_initial_forward_window
features.formula: TCP window_size of the first forward TCP packet
features.zero_policy: 0 for UDP flows or before a forward TCP packet exists

features.name: tcp_initial_reverse_window
features.formula: TCP window_size of the first reverse TCP packet
features.zero_policy: 0 for UDP flows or before a reverse TCP packet exists

features.name: tcp_window_mean
features.formula: Welford mean of TCP window_size over all TCP packets
features.zero_policy: 0 for UDP flows or an empty group

features.name: tcp_window_std
features.formula: Welford population standard deviation of TCP window_size over all TCP packets
features.zero_policy: 0 for UDP flows or zero or one sample

features.name: ttl_min
features.formula: minimum IPv4 TTL over all packets

features.name: ttl_max
features.formula: maximum IPv4 TTL over all packets

features.name: ttl_mean
features.formula: Welford mean of IPv4 TTL over all packets

features.name: ttl_std
features.formula: Welford population standard deviation of IPv4 TTL over all packets

features.name: payload_packet_count
features.formula: count of packets whose PacketView.payload.length is greater than 0

features.name: forward_payload_packet_count
features.formula: count of forward packets whose PacketView.payload.length is greater than 0

features.name: reverse_payload_packet_count
features.formula: count of reverse packets whose PacketView.payload.length is greater than 0

features.name: payload_byte_count
features.formula: sum of PacketView.payload.length over all packets

features.name: forward_payload_byte_count
features.formula: sum of PacketView.payload.length over forward packets

features.name: reverse_payload_byte_count
features.formula: sum of PacketView.payload.length over reverse packets

features.name: payload_length_min
features.formula: minimum PacketView.payload.length over every packet, including zero-length payloads

features.name: payload_length_max
features.formula: maximum PacketView.payload.length over every packet, including zero-length payloads

features.name: payload_length_mean
features.formula: Welford mean of PacketView.payload.length over every packet, including zero-length payloads

features.name: payload_length_std
features.formula: Welford population standard deviation of PacketView.payload.length over every packet, including zero-length payloads

features.name: header_length_mean
features.formula: Welford mean of PacketView.payload.offset, the frame bytes preceding transport payload, over all packets

features.name: header_length_std
features.formula: Welford population standard deviation of PacketView.payload.offset, the frame bytes preceding transport payload, over all packets

features.name: protocol_number
features.formula: 6 for TCP and 17 for UDP; never dataset-factorized

features.name: forward_ttl_mean
features.formula: Welford mean of IPv4 TTL over forward packets

features.name: reverse_ttl_mean
features.formula: Welford mean of IPv4 TTL over reverse packets

features.name: forward_wire_bit_rate_per_second
features.formula: forward_wire_byte_count * 8 * 1000000.0 / flow_age_us

features.name: reverse_wire_bit_rate_per_second
features.formula: reverse_wire_byte_count * 8 * 1000000.0 / flow_age_us

features.name: active_mean_us
features.formula: mean duration of active segments under active_idle_policy
features.zero_policy: 0 when the only active segment is a singleton

features.name: idle_mean_us
features.formula: mean duration of gaps classified as idle under active_idle_policy

features.name: context_same_destination_endpoint_flow_count_60s
features.formula: frozen causal count for context_policy.same_destination_endpoint_key in the current fixed 60-second block

features.name: context_same_source_destination_flow_count_60s
features.formula: frozen causal count for context_policy.same_source_destination_key in the current fixed 60-second block

features.name: context_source_destination_distinct_destination_port_count_60s
features.formula: frozen causal distinct destination-port count for context_policy.same_source_destination_key in the current fixed 60-second block

features.name: first_observed_source_port
features.formula: source transport port on the first accepted packet that anchors forward direction
features.zero_policy: 0 is retained as a valid observed port

features.name: first_observed_destination_port
features.formula: destination transport port on the first accepted packet that anchors forward direction
features.zero_policy: 0 is retained as a valid observed port

features.name: lifecycle_tcp_reset
features.formula: 1 exactly when lifecycle_policy classifies the flow as tcp_reset

features.name: lifecycle_tcp_fin_handshake
features.formula: 1 exactly when lifecycle_policy classifies the flow as tcp_fin_handshake

features.name: lifecycle_tcp_other
features.formula: 1 exactly when lifecycle_policy classifies the flow as tcp_other

features.name: lifecycle_udp
features.formula: 1 exactly when lifecycle_policy classifies the flow as udp
